references.text: The Lord knows his people and knows who belongs to him, a theme repeated in the rebellion of Korah
The context of Korah's rebellion where they challenge the holiness and selection of Moses and Aaron
Continuation of Moses' response to Korah about whom the Lord will choose as holy
The Lord shows who he has chosen through Aaron's staff that blossoms
The priests shall be holy to their God, the theme of holiness and selection for service
Saul is chosen by casting lots; the Lord reveals whom he has chosen
Blessed is the one you choose and bring near, so that he may dwell in your courts
Reference to Korah's rebellion and the Lord's judgment on those who challenged the holy ones
The Lord knows his own, an echo of Moses' words that the Lord knows who belongs to him
Warning against Korah's rebellion as an example of disobedience to God's chosen leaders
